description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a Medical Exam Preparation Chatbot implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). It sets up the web interface, manages session state, loads chapters and conversation history, and defines an asynchronous function to generate answers based on retrieved textbook content using OpenAI's API.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing local vector storage and search functionality for textbook chunks.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class for managing text embeddings, used to convert questions into vector representations.

classes.name: AsyncOpenAI
classes.description: A class for asynchronously interacting with OpenAI's API for chat completions.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an answer to a question by retrieving relevant textbook chunks and querying OpenAI's API with a prompt that includes the context.
